note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries. New wave-2 template distilled from a field workflow pattern; all records are fictional.

cases.onepager_bullet: Lists every briefing format with its audience and sections so the right template is chosen first
cases.prompt: What briefing formats can you build for us?

cases.onepager_bullet: Shows what the governed content set holds on a topic, document by document
cases.prompt: What do we hold on the Elm Street Bridge Replacement?

cases.onepager_bullet: Flags measures that carry different values in different documents before they reach a brief
cases.prompt: Before I draft anything, do any of the figures disagree?

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts the brief in the chosen template with a cited source behind every section
cases.prompt: Draft the budget hearing brief on the Elm Street bridge.

cases.onepager_bullet: Names the sections with no supporting content so input is requested early
cases.prompt: Which sections of that brief still need input?

cases.onepager_bullet: Shows who reviews and approves each format and how long sign-off takes
cases.prompt: Who signs this brief off, and how long does it take?
must_include: No brief was sent for approval

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
